class.name: SiEffectAutopan
class.description: Applies an LFO to each input channel independently, preserving the stereo input. The stereo width controls the phase difference between the left and right LFOs. A width of 0 modulates both channels together like tremolo; a width of 1 places their LFOs 180 degrees apart. The LFO runs free: it restarts only when the effect is reset. A tempo-synced rate follows tempo changes at the next block.

method.name: set_params
method.description: Sets the LFO rate, its stereo phase offset and its shape. A [param stereo_width] of 1 is a 180 degree offset. [param rate_mode] picks the rate: 0 for [param frequency] in hertz, 1 for a period of [param time] milliseconds, 2 for a [param sync_division] at the song tempo, 3 for a dotted one and 4 for a triplet one. [param sync_division] runs from a whole note (0) to a 1/32 note (5). [param shape] is sine (0), triangle (1), saw up (2), saw down (3), square (4), noise (5) or sample and hold (6).
